screening_decisions.reason: RCT of adjuvant medroxyprogesterone acetate (MPA) in women with stage 1 endometrial cancer after surgery. Patients were randomised to MPA vs no treatment or radiotherapy vs radiotherapy plus MPA.
This is a review/survey of literature on progestin therapy, not a randomised controlled trial. It summarizes observations from multiple studies rather than being a primary RCT.
This is a methodological paper about measuring inconsistency in meta-analyses, not an RCT of progestagen therapy for endometrial cancer.

Randomised controlled trial of adjuvant progesterone therapy in women with Stage I or II endometrial cancer after surgery. 1148 patients randomised to progesterone vs no additional therapy.
This is a methodological paper about meta-analysis in clinical trials, not an RCT of progestagen therapy for endometrial cancer.
Randomised trial of progestogens as part of primary treatment of endometrial carcinoma in conjunction with surgery and radiotherapy. 429 patients randomised to progestogen or control group.
This is a methodological paper about extracting summary statistics for meta-analyses of survival endpoints, not an RCT of progestagen therapy for endometrial cancer.
Randomised controlled trial of adjuvant progesterone therapy (6-methyl-17α-hydroxyprogesterone) in 35 patients with stage 1 endometrial cancer after hysterectomy and bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy.

Prospective randomised clinical trial of adjuvant progestagen therapy in 205 patients with endometrial cancer after hysterectomy. Patients randomised to progestagen treatment vs no additional therapy.
